==Notes==
*If you have not completed the quest [[Drakes on the Plain]] yet, make sure you don't include [[Koss]] in your party, otherwise Zelnehlun Fastfoot will not spawn.
*To trigger Zelnehlun Fastfoot and his mob, walk towards the resurrection shrine near the fortress.
